title: Clearly identify the data people need to enter

statement.en: Clearly identify the data people need to provide.
statement.ja: 入力が必要なdataを明確に示す。

conditions: Use a field prompt or introductory label to describe the expected information.
Prefill only reasonable default values that reduce decisions and speed entry.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Entering data experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるEntering dataの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Use secure entry for sensitive data

statement.en: When collecting sensitive data, use a secure text-entry field that obscures the input.
statement.ja: sensitive dataを収集する場合、inputを隠すsecure text-entry fieldを使う。

conditions: Apply when the app or game needs people to enter sensitive data.
A tvOS digit-entry view can obscure entered numerals.
A system-provided visionOS secure field hides entered data from people other than the wearer.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Entering data experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるEntering dataの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Consider an expansion tooltip for clipped macOS field text

statement.en: Consider an expansion tooltip that shows the complete text when a macOS field clips or truncates it.
statement.ja: macOS fieldでtextがclippedまたはtruncatedになる場合は、全文を示すexpansion tooltipを検討する。

conditions: The field is too small to display the complete entered data.
This applies to macOS apps, including iOS and iPadOS apps running on a Mac.
The expansion tooltip appears when the pointer rests over the field.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Entering data experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
